name: Trombone
shortDescription: Tenor brass instrument using a telescoping slide to continuously vary air-column length and pitch.
description: The trombone is unique among brass instruments in using a telescoping slide rather than valves for pitch control. Moving the slide through seven positions changes the total tube length (2.75m to 3.5m), shifting the harmonic series downward by semitone steps. The player's embouchure (lip tension) selects which partial of the harmonic series sounds, enabling a full chromatic range.
historicalOrigins: Developed in the 15th century as the 'sackbut', the trombone is one of the oldest continuously-used brass instruments. Its slide mechanism appeared before valves were invented for other brass instruments.
acousticPrinciples: Lip reed: buzzing lips at the mouthpiece excite the air column at the player-selected harmonic partial
Slide positions change total tube length, shifting the entire harmonic series: each position = one semitone lower
Bell flare acts as acoustic impedance transformer matching narrow bore to wide atmospheric radiation
The trombone can produce a true glissando by sliding continuously between positions

characteristics.timbralColor: Rich, dark, weighty; bright in upper register; buzzy fortissimo
characteristics.orchestralRole: Bass/tenor harmony, chorale doubling, powerful accent, glissando effects

soundDNA.exciter: Vibrating lip reed in cupped mouthpiece (Helmholtz oscillator)
soundDNA.resonator: Cylindrical slide bore + conical bell section air column
soundDNA.harmonics: Complete harmonic series; fundamental (pedal tone) through 6th partial
soundDNA.attackDecay: Controlled by air velocity and tongue articulation; sustained indefinitely when blown
soundDNA.timbreProfile: Rich dark fundamental, strong lower partials, brass formant peak 900–1200 Hz
soundDNA.radiationPattern: Directional forward radiation from bell opening; back pressure felt by player

mouthpiece.label: Mouthpiece
mouthpiece.function: Deep-cup mouthpiece positions lips optimally for buzzing. Cup depth shapes timbral brightness.

characteristics.mechanism: Lip reed cavity coupling to bore resonance
characteristics.role: Lip reed interface and initial resonator

slide_outer.label: Outer Slide
slide_outer.function: Outer stocking slides over inner tubes. Moving to 7 positions extends total tube length in semitone steps.

characteristics.material: Nickel-silver outer slide with chrome-plated inner
characteristics.mechanism: Telescoping tube extension: Δposition = Δpitch by semitone
characteristics.role: Continuous pitch control via length variation

slide_inner.label: Inner Slide
slide_inner.function: Precision-ground inner slide tubes with beaded stockings guiding smooth frictionless motion.

characteristics.material: Chrome-plated brass inner slide with seamless drawn tubing
characteristics.mechanism: Sub-millimetre clearance for air-tight sliding motion

bell_section.label: Bell Flare
bell_section.function: Conical bell flare acts as acoustic impedance transformer improving radiation efficiency.

characteristics.material: Yellow or rose brass, hand-hammered bell (8" diameter)
characteristics.mechanism: Flare profile tunes radiation efficiency and brightness

tuning_slide.label: Tuning Slide
tuning_slide.function: U-shaped slide in the bell section for overall tuning adjustment (A=440 Hz standard).

characteristics.material: Yellow brass with thumb trigger option
characteristics.mechanism: Additive tube length for overall A=440 calibration

followTheSound.title: Lip Reed Vibration
followTheSound.explanation: Player's buzzing lips act as a Helmholtz oscillator, exciting harmonics at the cup resonance frequency.

followTheSound.title: Slide Position
followTheSound.explanation: Slide position changes total tube length. Position 1=Bb, Position 7=E — seven semitone steps.

followTheSound.title: Air Column Resonance
followTheSound.explanation: The full tube length (2.75–3.5m) determines which harmonic series the embouchure selects from.

followTheSound.title: Bell Radiation
followTheSound.explanation: Bell flare opens from ~13mm bore to 220mm diameter, dramatically improving radiation into the room.
